findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

Several cans of cream of coconut were observed with major dents and stored on the rack as if they were ready for use. When discussed the PIC stated that they had already requested a refund, however it would be easy for an employee to grab a can and use it as if it were available and safe to use. Once asked, the PIC moved the cans to the back by their desk so that they were separated and not easily used by mistake. Ensure that foods with damaged packaging are stored separately from foods intended for service to prevent possible mistakes and illnesses.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(C) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (C) If used with TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD, EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned throughout the day at least every 4 hours.

The potato slicer in the middle hallway is observed with dried on potato remains during this inspection, including the top of the last potato sliced. The PIC was consulted and stated that this equipment was used last this morning around 9:30 AM and would not likely be used again today. This equipment should be cleaned after use each morning. It was disassembled by staff and moved to dish for cleaning to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned after use and at least every four hours while in use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple items stored on the shelves in the equipment storage area were observed with remaining food debris. These items were shown to the PIC and moved back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all dishes are thoroughly cleaned prior to storage and use. This has been a consistent issue over the past several years.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

Two of the three sani buckets in the facility were observed with low concentrations of quaternary ammonia in solution per the inspector’s test strips. The PIC was shown and remade the buckets to correct the violation. Ensure that all sanitizers in use are maintained at effective concentrations at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

Tuna poke was observed with internal temperatures ranging from 51F-53F in the cold well at the prep line. This is a situation that arose several years ago and was fixed at that time by using deeper pans so that the food was maintained deeper in the cold holding under the pans. The current batch was brought from a cooler at approximately 11 am. Six hours at this temperature range lands at 5 pm. The PIC agreed to discard the container at that time. Deeper pans were brought out for the next batch and should be used moving forward.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

Raw eggs are observed over lettuce and cooked pasta in the walk in cooler. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-arrange the items. They did and the violation is considered corrected at this time. Ensure that foods are stored according to their cooking temperatures so that cross contamination is not a concern moving forward.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The dish machine would not register sanitizer on either the inspector’s or facility’s test strips. Investigation showed the jug of concentrate was empty and another is not available in the facility at the time of this inspection. The PIC called the general manager and they stated that they would pick up a new jug on the way in today. The facility will avoid doing dishes until the GM arrives with the new jug to simplify the situation. The facility does have the ability to use the three compartment sink and sanitizer is available for this process. The procedures for that were reviewed with the inspector during this inspection. Ensure that the sanitizers in the facility are maintained at effective use at all times. The inspector will SPOT CHECK tomorrow to vrerify that the sanitizer is in use as stated. Violations may be added tomorrow if not.

findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(C) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (C) If used with TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD, EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned throughout the day at least every 4 hours.

The potato slicer in the middle hallway is observed with dried on potato remains during this inspection, including the top of the last potato sliced. The PIC was consulted and stated that this equipment was used last this morning around 9:30 AM and would not likely be used again today. This equipment should be cleaned after use each morning. It was disassembled by staff and moved to dish for cleaning to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned after use and at least every four hours while in use.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(1) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained: (1) At 57°C (135°F) or above.

Five pans of rice and two quarter pans of pork in the hot holding unit in the middle hallway are observed with internal temperatures of 103F to 128F. The PIC was consulted and voluntarily discarded the items to correct the immediate violation. They stated that the equipment has been having issues for a while and a work order has been put in for maintenance. Multiple suggestions were given by the inspector with the simplest being to use the spare steam well as well as the bottom tray of the hot holding unit at the corner of the service counter. The hot holding unit should not be used for hot holding TCS foods until maintenance can be inducted. Because these foods are being discarded the immediate violation is being considered corrected at this time. The inspector may spot check in the coming weeks to ensure that TCS foods are properly hot held moving forward.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

A container of cooked macaroni noodles in the walk in cooler is without date marking. When asked, the PIC believed that the noodles were prepared one or two days ago. Education was conducted. To correct the immediate violation a date mark was placed on the noodles container. Ensure that all TCS foods are properly date marked at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Multiple locations throughout the back two hallways and in the walk in cooler need the floors swept and mopped. These areas are primarily under the shelving and counters. The PIC was told and instructed to clean these locations regularly and consistently to prevent accumulation of filth. Ensure the facility is cleaned regularly and consistently.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

The mop sink is pulling away from the wall and producing a gap. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal/re-caulk prior to the next routine inspection to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface. Ensure that all surfaces around moisture and foods are maintained smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani buckets in the facility would barely register a change on the inspector’s tests trips. The buckets were remade during this inspection to effective concentration to correct. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective levels at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A)  TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY (TCS) FOOD shall be maintained: (2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

The tuna poke in the cold holding well on the front prep line is observed with internal temperatures of 66F. The PIC was shown and discarded the container to correct. A deeper well was acquired to help with future storage options. Ensure that all TCS foods are stored at safe temperatures at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

An employee was observed to don gloves without hand washing. Education was conducted and the PIC is instructed to ensure that hand washing is taking place at all times that it should be.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

On arrival the hand sink in the service area is observed with a trash can, a broom and a dust pan blocking access. The PIC was shown and moved the items prior to the inspector discussing the situation. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained accessible for ready use at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

Several cans are observed in dry storage with major dents in the sides and tops. The PIC was shown and moved the items to the back for credit to correct. Education was conducted. Ensure that all cans are recieved and maintained in good working order at all times of storage and until use/service.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x4) 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple food contact surfaces in the facility are observed soiled in such a way that it appears that they were not sufficiently/completely cleaned prior to storage. Items include: 1) knives in the knife rack in the middle hallway; 2) pan lids on the racks int he middle hallway and; 3) lettuce tongs on the front line. All items were shown to the PIC and moved back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all dishes are cleaned completely each time prior to storage for use. This is the 5th inspection in a row where this situation has been a concern! Ensure that the dish washers are educated and needed oversight is taking place to ensure that the food contact surfaces are clean!

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(C) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (C) Except as specified in (D) of this section, if used with TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD, EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned throughout the day at least every 4 hours.

The wedge slicer is observed soiled with dry food debris during this inspection. When asked the PIC indicated that it had not been used today, indicating that it was not cleaned at the end of last night and has been soiled for greater than 18 hours minimum. The PIC moved the slicer to dish for cleaning to correct.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD (TCS) shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

A container of minced garlic in oil with other seasoning is observed on a shelf in the middle hallway. Garlic in oil is considered a TCS food and needs temperature control for safety. The PIC was notified and education conducted. The container was discarded during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. The PIC is instructed to store this item in a refrigerator moving forward.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe: (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

The cutting boards are deeply scoured and in need of replacing. The PIC was consulted and made aware of the cleaning/contamination concerns related to this and is being instructed to replace these items prior to the next routine inspection. findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

Allergen training is not available for the CFPM at the facility during this inspection. Allergen training was discussed and they are instructed to maintain allergen training for all CFPPMs at all times.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

This is the fifth inspection in a row where a CFPM violation is being awarded. Per Greg there is another person (Carlee) at the point where they are ready to take the test and become certified. Another person is not currently in our system but works at the facility per Greg (Josiah Collazo). John goes between the locations in Springfield and Carlinville. Per the food program supervisor we will conduct a 30 day follow up to allow for a minimum of two more employees to receive the needed certification. If not complete, we are at the point in the enforcement process where a compliance conference with the director of Public Health will be needed.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

A container of half n’ half is observed in a pan with minimal water/ice in the bottom. Discussion showed this to be a new practice related to smoothies now available. An internal temperature of 51F was taken from the container. The PIC indicated that the container had only been out since 11 today but was likely out all of yesterday in a similar set up. The container was discarded during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. Education was conducted and the inspector stated that ice generally needs to be higher than the level of the food when using an ice bath. The pan used only reaches approximately 3/4 of the way up the container of half n’ half making this impossible in the current situation. An internal temperature of 41F or less is required by code for all cold held TCS foods.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below). 

A can of spray stainless steel cleaner is observed on the prep cooler (not in use) to the right of the hot holding unit (in use) in the middle hallway. Ensure that chemicals not intended for use on food contact surffaces are stored away from food contact surfaces to prevent possible contamination of the surfaces. The can was moved to the chemical storage in the back during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 

 Wiping cloths are observed moist and sitting on counters in the middle area of the facility. Ensure that these items are stored between uses in sanitizer of correct concentration to inhibit the growth of pathogenic organisms. The rag was removed during this inspection to correct.

findings.comment:

A pan of mac n’ cheese is observed stored on the shelf under the oven at the front of the facility without any form of cold holding.
